messages:
emily.presales: Kicking off the NovaHealth POC today. Client wants streaming predictions (SSE preferred) + function-calls for EHR lookups. Need structured JSON per patient summary and partial/real-time updates. Also flagged: SSO + on‑prem KMS for PHI. Who can own the tech checklist?

ben.sales: I can drive scheduling and pricing questions. Quick ones: are we recommending Dedicated for on‑prem KMS or can Hosted with VPC be ok for the POC?

raj.se: @emily.presales @ben.sales short answer: Hosted VPC can work for the POC if traffic is low and they accept transient keys, but for PHI/on‑prem KMS we usually advise Dedicated or Private. Need to confirm KMS rotation requirements.

amanda.eng: For streaming + partial outputs, recommend SSE with chunked structured JSON. We have an example payload pattern:

```
event: prediction
data: {"patient_id":"12345","summary_partial":true,"chunks":[{"type":"header","text":"Vitals OK"},{"type":"meds","text":"metformin 500mg"}]}

```

This lets the client render partial cards as tokens arrive.

luke.sdk: SDK note: v0.12+ supports streaming callbacks + function-calls out of the box. For the POC, use the `stream()` helper and set `structured_output: true`. Example (JS):

```js
const resp = await client.stream({model: 'redwood-rt-1', input, structured_output: true, onChunk: (c) => render(c)});
```

emily.presales: Great — thanks. Two asks from the client: 1) sample app showing EHR lookup flow with function-calls, and 2) security questionnaire answers about KMS and audit logs. Can we turn those around in 48h?

raj.se: I can do the sample app skeleton — will wire function-calls to a mocked EHR endpoint. @luke.sdk can you add a short README for the JS snippet and a cURL example?

luke.sdk: Yep, I'll push a minimal demo repo. cURL streaming example: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"input":"...","structured_output":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream`

sec-bot: Security checklist: on‑prem KMS = customer-managed keys required; audit logs available via Console (retention depends on plan). Will compile answers to the questionnaire and attach.

ben.sales: Pricing question from procurement: if they go Dedicated for 3 months POC, is there a short-term reserved pricing or monthly commit? Also need ballpark for Dedicated with 2x A100-ish capacity for parallel streams.

amanda.eng: We have short-term committed tiers — PM can provide a three-month quote. Ballpark: Dedicated baseline + usage; I'll ask finance for an estimate for 2x A100 equiv, but expect ~Xx hosted cost (will follow up).

emily.presales: Risk/enterprise blockers: SSO/SAML integration, SOC2 evidence, and certifying the on‑prem KMS flow. We should list acceptance criteria for the POC so legal/security sign off is clear.

raj.se: Proposed POC acceptance criteria: 1) streaming partial summaries rendered in client within 500ms token latency for baseline load, 2) function-call EHR lookup completes and returns structured JSON, 3) audit logs show KMS key usage, 4) SSO works in their test idP. If all green, we handoff to integrations.

luke.sdk: One more note: structured output schema — we should agree on a small JSON schema (patient_id, section, severity, confidence). I'll draft a schema and include it in the demo README.

emily.presales: Timeline: Day 0–1: mock EHR + README, Day 2: demo run with client, Day 3–5: security questionnaire + pricing quote. @ben.sales will confirm slots.

ben.sales: Confirmed — putting a 30m demo on Tom from NovaHealth's calendar for Day 2 (calendar invite sent).

amanda.eng: I'll message infra to standby for a possible Dedicated test deploy. cc @raj.se

raj.se: For follow-ups: I'll open a short runbook with handshake steps (auth, streaming headers, function-call schema). Posting the link here when ready. :thumbsup:

emily.presales: Awesome — thanks team. If anything blocks the 48h deliverable call it out here.
